title_en: Guiding Case No. 246: Miao et al. v. Mudanjiang Prison, Heilongjiang Province — compensation claim for death due to failure to perform supervisory duties
ruling_gist_en: Where detention centers, prisons, and other supervisory authorities and their personnel violate laws, regulations, and relevant provisions by failing to timely exercise supervision and handle incidents of injury to detainees and inmates, and such failure is causally related to the injury or death of the detainees and inmates, it constitutes neglect of supervisory duties. The compensatory authority shall bear state compensation liability. At the same time, the people's court shall comprehensively consider factors such as the role played by the neglect of supervisory duties in the occurrence and aggravation of the harmful result, the degree of fault, and other factors, and shall lawfully and reasonably determine the proportion of liability and the amount of compensation to be borne by the compensatory authority.

full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 246

Miao A et al. v. Mudanjiang Prison of Heilongjiang Province — compensation for death due to dereliction of supervision duties

(Adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court on December 23, 2024)

Keywords: state compensation; compensation for death due to dereliction of supervision duties; liability for compensation; degree of fault

Ruling Gist

When custodial institutions such as detention centers and prisons, as well as their staff, violate laws, regulations, and relevant provisions by failing to timely take supervisory measures when detainees or prisoners are subjected to injury incidents, and such failure is causally related to the injury or death of the detainees or prisoners, it constitutes dereliction of supervisory duties, and the organ liable for compensation shall bear state compensation liability. Meanwhile, the people's court shall comprehensively consider factors such as the role of such dereliction of supervisory duties in the occurrence and expansion of the damage result and the degree of fault, and reasonably determine the proportion of liability and the amount of compensation to be borne by the organ liable for compensation in accordance with the law.

Basic Facts

On March 24, 2003, in a sub-detention area of Mudanjiang Prison of Heilongjiang Province, at a certain mending workshop of a woolen textile mill in Mudanjiang City where prisoners were assigned to outside labor, Zhao A, a prisoner serving as the group leader of inmates, called the reported prisoner Miao B to the aisle next to the mending machine, verbally abused and scolded him, then punched Miao B's head for several minutes until he knocked him to the ground. When Miao B fell, he hit the back of his head on the ground and lost consciousness. During this period, Jiao A, the sub-detention area chief responsible for supervising the safety of prisoners' labor and production in the workshop, failed to perform his supervisory duties such as patrolling and watching. He only discovered the situation after Miao B was beaten to the ground and unconscious, and then organized personnel to send him to the hospital for treatment. Miao B died on the 28th of the same month despite rescue efforts. The Intermediate People's Court of Mudanjiang, Heilongjiang Province tried the case and rendered a criminal judgment, convicting Zhao A of intentional injury and sentencing him to death with a two-year reprieve and deprivation of political rights for life. The People's Court of Ning'an, Heilongjiang Province also rendered a criminal judgment, finding Jiao A guilty of dereliction of duty but exempting him from criminal punishment.

Based on the above facts, Miao A (father of Miao B) applied for state compensation to Mudanjiang Prison of Heilongjiang Province. Mudanjiang Prison issued Reply Letter No. 2 (2009) of the Legal Affairs Office of Mudanjiang Prison, refusing compensation to Miao A. Miao A applied for reconsideration, and the Prison Administration Bureau of Heilongjiang Province issued Criminal Compensation Reconsideration Decision No. 3 (2009), affirming the decision of Reply Letter No. 2. Miao A, Chen (wife of Miao B), Miao C (son of Miao B), and Miao D (elder brother of Miao B) applied to the Compensation Committee of the Heilongjiang High People's Court for a compensation decision.

Judgment

The Compensation Committee of the Heilongjiang High People's Court rendered State Compensation Decision No. 12 (2017) on July 24, 2017:

1. Repeal Criminal Compensation Reconsideration Decision No. 3 (2009) of the Prison Administration Bureau of Heilongjiang Province and Reply Letter No. 2 (2009) of the Legal Affairs Office of Mudanjiang Prison;
2. Mudanjiang Prison of Heilongjiang Province shall pay Miao A, Chen, and Miao C death compensation and funeral expenses totaling RMB 405,414;
3. Mudanjiang Prison of Heilongjiang Province shall make an apology to Miao A, Chen, and Miao C, pay RMB 60,000 as solatium for mental distress, pay RMB 15,000 as living expenses to Miao C, and pay RMB 2,331 as medical expenses to Miao A, Chen, and Miao C, and dismiss the other state compensation claims of Miao A, Chen, and Miao C, and dismiss the state compensation claim of Miao D.

Miao A and Miao D filed a petition with the Compensation Committee of the Supreme People's Court. The Compensation Committee of the Supreme People's Court rendered Decision No. 145 (2020) on September 21, 2020: rejected the petition of Miao A and Miao D.

Reasoning

Article 17, Item (4) of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Where an organ exercising the functions of investigation, prosecution, or adjudication, or a detention center or prison administration authority, or its staff, while exercising its functions, commits any of the following acts infringing upon the personal rights of a person, the victim has the right to obtain compensation: ... (4) extorting a confession by torture, or causing bodily injury or death to a citizen by assault, abuse, or by instigating or conniving at assault or abuse by others; ..." Prisons bear the statutory duty of supervision and protection over the personal safety, life, and health of prisoners during their sentence. If a prison or its staff fails to perform such supervisory and protective duties, resulting in personal injury or death of a prisoner, it also falls within the circumstances regulated by the above provision. In this case, Zhao A's assault was the direct cause of Miao B's death. However, the failure of Mudanjiang Prison of Heilongjiang Province and its staff Jiao A to perform supervisory and protective duties also had a certain connection with the death of prisoner Miao B, and therefore they shall bear corresponding compensation liability.

Unlike intentional acts such as assault or abuse, the failure of supervisory personnel to perform their supervisory duties resulting in injury or death of a person under supervision is a negligent act, and their subjective state is not to pursue or allow the occurrence of damage; moreover, such failure generally combines with other factors to jointly cause the damage. Therefore, taking into account the degree of supervisory dereliction of Mudanjiang Prison of Heilongjiang Province and its role in the death, and in accordance with the law, it is determined that Mudanjiang Prison shall bear corresponding state compensation liability, that is, pay Miao A, Chen, and Miao C death compensation and funeral expenses totaling RMB 405,414, and solatium of RMB 60,000; and also pay the living expenses of the deceased's dependents who lack the ability to work and the medical expenses incurred for treating the deceased.

Relevant Legal Provision

Article 17 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China
